blocks.text: If you have just bought a product, such as a stereo or an air-conditioner, and it stops working after a short period of time, what can you do? You have to read the warranty so you’ll know what to do.

A warranty is a promise given by a company that makes a product. It tells you what the company is willing to do if the product breaks or stops working. Reading a warranty before you buy a product may help you to spend your money wisely.
Most warranties give the following information:

items: *a.–* What is covered by the warranty.
*b.–* How long the product is covered.
*c.–* Conditions under which something will be fixed or replaced.
*d.–* What to do if the product needs to be replaced or repaired.

blocks.text: Sometimes the words used in warranties are confusing. If you don’t understand a word, look it up in a dictionary. If you still do not know what the warranty means, ask the sales person.

It is a good idea to keep the sales receipt with the warranty for a product. If a product was given to you as a gift, write the date this product was given to you on the warranty. This way you will be able to prove when you received the product.
Limited Warranty

Smart Buy Computer Company is sure that the Home Computer 2000 you just purchased is of the highest quality. However, we realize that occasionally there may be a defect. This warranty guarantees that if the home computer you have purchased is defective, Smart Buy Computer Company will fix or replace all parts with new or rebuilt parts for a period of one year from the original date of purchase. Some electrical parts are covered for two years from the original date of purchase. Any labor charges must be paid by the customer.

This warranty covers only computers that are found to be defective in normal use. This does not include computers that are used in school or business settings. This warranty does not cover any damage caused by any kind of misuse, faulty wiring, lightning, or service performed by anyone other than someone authorized in writing by this company. The cabinet and keyboard are not covered by this warranty.

If you need repairs in this product, write to Smart Buy Computer Company, Consumer Services Departament, 876 Memory Road, Little Rock, Arkansas 72212. Include a description of the problem, proof of the date of original purchase, and your name and address. DO NOT have this product serviced without written instructions from this company.
This warranty gives you specific legal rights. You may also have other rights, which vary from state to state.
Answer:

items.q: What does this warranty cover?
For how long will the company fix or replace all parts?
What does authorized mean in the second paragraph?
What kinds of damages are not covered by this warranty?
If you need to have this machine fixed, what should you do?
What is covered for two years by this warranty?
Who makes this product?
What parts of this product, if any, are not covered by this warranty?
Will this product always be repaired with new parts?
What will you pay if you have the product repaired?

blocks.text: Limited One-Year Warranty

Score Athletic Products, Inc. promises to fix or replace your Score tennis racket for one full year from date of purchase should it prove to be defective with normal use. This warranty does not cover strings or handgrips.
This warranty is void if the tennis racket has been misused in any way or if the defect is caused by any service performed on the racket by anyone other than Score Athletic Products, Inc.
A sales receipt or other proof of the original date of purchase must be provided before any service will be given by this company.

If a problem should develop within the warranty period, send the defective racket along with your name and address and proof of the original purchase date to *Score Athletic Products, Inc., Customer Service Departament, 1010 Sport Drive, Austin, Texas 78750.*
Please include a check or money order for $ 4.50 to cover postage and handling charges. This warranty gives you specific legal rights. You may also have other rights, which vary from state to state.
Answer:

items.q: For how long will the company fix or replace the tennis racket?
What isn’t covered by this warranty?
What do void, misused and defect mean?
What must you prove before having the racket fixed or replaced?

blocks.text: Write a dialogue. (See function).
You just bought an alarm clock from a shop. The clock slows down ten minutes every hour. Go to the shop and complain to the sales assistant.
Change the following sentences into the passive form.

items: My mother bought that hat.
That hat was bought by my mother.

items.q: She was baking a cake this morning.
A thief took the jewels.
You must take care of him.
They’re publishing Jim’s book in a two volume edition.
The mechanic repaired the car.
We have cooked meals in those pots for years.
May answers all the questions.
They will wash all the windows.

blocks.text: When we complain about a product or a service we can use these expressions:

items: – I want to return this … (stereo, Camera, etc)
– It doesn’t … (Work, fit)
– I want my money back on these … (Stocking, shoes, etc)
– They were … (torn, broken, etc.)
– They are … (too big, expensive, etc)
– I must complain about the … (service, food, etc)
